description: Shared DetailHeader component + make the Standards index rows navigable + the full STANDARDS hierarchy (product detail -> versions table -> version detail with Assets & Compatibilities tabs). Establishes the shared presentational component and the flat-param routing pattern that FEAT-002 reuses. Independent of FEAT-002's data but FEAT-002 depends on the DetailHeader and the index-wiring pattern created here, so this runs first.
steps:
Create src/components/data/detail-header.tsx: presentational Card-based definition list. Props `{ fields: { label: string; value: React.ReactNode }[] }`. Render `` with a `grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-x-6 gap-y-3` of field blocks; each block: `
{label}
` over `
{value}
`. No data fetching. Export `DetailHeader`, `DetailField` (and `DetailHeaderProps`). No `any`.

Create src/routes/_app/standards/products/$standardId.tsx. `createFileRoute('/_app/standards/products/$standardId')`. Read `const { standardId } = Route.useParams()`. Header: `useGetStandard(standardId)` -> DetailHeader fields Code/Name/Provider/Family/Product type/Scope; while isLoading render Skeleton blocks; on isError render ErrorState({error, resourceLabel:'standard product'}). PageHeader title = product ? `${product.code} — ${product.name}` : 'Standard product'; actions/above: ghost Button in `<Link to='/standards'>` labelled 'Back to standards'. Versions: `useListStandardVersions(standardId)` -> ResourceTable columns: version; lifecycle (cell: StatusBadge); content_schema_version; publication_date (cell: formatDate); created_at (cell: formatDate). onRowClick -> navigate({ to:'/standards/versions/$versionId', params:{ versionId: row.id } }). getRowId=row=>row.id, resourceLabel='standard versions'.

Create src/routes/_app/standards/versions/$versionId.tsx. `createFileRoute('/_app/standards/versions/$versionId')`. `const { versionId } = Route.useParams()`. Header: `useGetStandardVersion(versionId)` -> DetailHeader fields Version, Lifecycle(StatusBadge), Content schema, Checksum, Publication date(formatDate), Created(formatDate), Applicable modules(`version.applicable_modules.join(', ') || '—'`), Purposes(join || '—'). PageHeader title = version ? `Version ${version.version}` : 'Standard version'. Back: once loaded a Link `to='/standards/products/$standardId' params={{ standardId: version.product_id }}` ('Back to product'); fallback Link to '/standards'. Tabs (Tabs/TabsList/TabsTrigger/TabsContent) 'assets' + 'compatibilities'. Assets tab: `useListStandardAssets(versionId)` -> ResourceTable columns role, media_type, checksum, title(cell: row.title ?? '—'), resource_type(cell: row.resource_type ?? '—'), required(cell: row.required ? 'Yes':'No'), canonical_href(cell: row.canonical_href ? link : '—'); resourceLabel='assets'. Compatibilities tab: `useListStandardCompatibilities(versionId)` -> ResourceTable columns relationship, target_version_id, required(cell Yes/No); resourceLabel='compatibilities'. Do NOT call useGetStandardAssetContent. Do NOT render provenance/compatibility/evidence objects.

Modify src/routes/_app/standards.tsx: keep PageHeader + Tabs + columns unchanged. In ProductsTab and ReleasesTab and TemplatesTab add `const navigate = useNavigate()` (import useNavigate from '@tanstack/react-router') and pass onRowClick to each ResourceTable: products -> navigate({to:'/standards/products/$standardId', params:{standardId: row.id}}); releases -> navigate({to:'/standards/releases/$releaseId', params:{releaseId: row.id}}); templates -> navigate({to:'/standards/templates/$templateId', params:{templateId: row.id}}). NOTE: the releases and templates target routes are created in FEAT-002; if building FEAT-001 alone before FEAT-002 exists, the typed `to` for those two will not yet resolve — in that case wire ONLY the products onRowClick in FEAT-001 and leave a clearly-marked TODO comment for releases/templates onRowClick to be added in FEAT-002 (FEAT-002 completes the wiring). Products onRowClick MUST be wired and working in FEAT-001.
Run the gate from the frontend dir and fix any type/lint errors before marking complete.

DONE. Gate green: `npm run build` 0 type errors; `npm run lint` 0 errors / 3 known warnings (badge.tsx, button.tsx, sidebar.tsx).

FOR FEAT-002:
- DetailHeader import: `import { DetailHeader } from '@/components/data/detail-header'`. It also exports types `DetailField` and `DetailHeaderProps`.
